title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality recording of a mixed‑energy show that shines on the uptempo “Eyes of the World” and a strong “The Other One”, with an unusual psychedelic undercurrent.
ai_review.review: The performance swings between sloppy, lazy moments and intense, psychedelic passages. Highlights include a fast, fantastic “Eyes of the World,” a nicely rendered “The Other One,” and the unique appearance of the Scope. The recording is uneven out‑of‑the‑box but sounds much better after EQ adjustment.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give an average of 3.5 stars; comments point to a decent show with notable peaks but uneven playing, and a recording that is uneven yet salvageable with EQ. This yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the recording is tough to get even; levels are uneven, but applying EQ makes it very good.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Limited commentary on flow; reviewers mention a unique inclusion of the Scope and an overall mixed energy level.
